recent_fun: Tag that friend who says "Bas 5 km hai, 10 minute mein pahunch jaunga" and then reaches after 1 hour 40 minutes.
Bali mein traffic mein koi honk nahi karta. Delhi mein signal pe hari batti ka intezaar bhi nahi hota, peeche se orchestra shuru ho jaata hai.
Udta Teer: "Cleaner release window chahiye." Mera dost: "Bhai aaj ka plan cancel, kal dekhte hain." Dono ko Drishyam 3 se clash hai.
Dost Dubai shift hua: "Yahan luxury normal hai, bro."  Wahi dost jo kal tak chai ke 20 rupaye ka UPI split karta tha.
G7 Zoom call mein camera off ho gaya, internet bola nap ya bad hair day. Hum students 3 saal se yahi bahana de rahe hain: "Sir, camera kharab hai."
Naye shehar mein 1.5 saal baad chhoti cheezein pasand aane lagi hain: A) Thandi hawa B) Traffic mein mila free 'me time' Tum kya choose karoge?
Ek baar report time pe bhej di. Ab boss: "Tum toh fast ho, ye 3 aur le lo." Your best becomes your baseline. Ab main jaanbujhkar 'working on it' bolta hoon.
Expectation: Job lagegi toh Mercedes aayegi. Reality: Saturday dopahar ki 2 ghante ki neend hi ab asli luxury hai.
Gen Z cousin: "Bhaiya, har mahine enough money bhej dena." Main: "Enough kitna hota hai?" Cousin: "Jitna aapko lage ki aap mana nahi kar sakte."
Ghar pe bachha: 10 baar bolo tab ek chamach khayega. Railway pantry ka oats: pura bowl saaf. Mummy ka mood: Beta, ab ticket permanent kara lete hain.
Manager ki purani Santro pe hanste the. Aaj pata chala: Uski gaadi loan-free hai, hamari 'status' 48 EMI mein hai.
Papa ne Drishyam 3 dekhi. Ab fridge se mithai gayab hone par: "Beta, 7 baje hum sab saath mein movie dekh rahe the. Yaad rakhna." Mummy: "Papa, ye alibi nahi chalega."
Producer: "Series hit hui, itne calls aaye!"  Mere phone ke calls: Mummy: "Khana khaya?" Bank: "Personal loan chahiye?" Padosi: "Wi-Fi password kya hai?"
Mon-Sat: 5 alarms bhi nahi uthate. Sunday subah 6 baje: body khud uth gayi. Dimaag: Bhai, aaj toh chhutti hai. Body: Pata hai, bas tujhe dikhana tha.
Family group mein poll: Front-load ya top-load? Papa: Jo sasta ho. Bua: Front-load, paani bachta hai. Mummy: Kuch mat lo, main haath se dho lungi. Poll band.
